sources: Owner-approved twin cities gameplay, graphics and expansion roadmap, 14 November 2026
title: The Next Repair
prose: A fresh reed is growing beside the drying frame. Irekha points out the old cut above it and the living root below.

choices.label: Look at the root
choices.line: The next repair is already growing beside the last one.

choices.label: Leave the bed undisturbed
choices.line: The work and the wet bank have something to give each other.
